messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-02-05] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Incident review INC-2025-004. The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01. Root cause: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-11-17] standup/dune/2025-11-17: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2025-03-17] standup/cinder/2025-03-17: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the product catalog.
- [2025-03-17] standup/boreal/2025-03-17: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-04-17] standup/cinder/2025-04-17: Decision: the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2025-06-11] handover/2025-06-11-notifier: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-05-29] standup/boreal/2025-05-29: For anything Boreal-related, page Marcus.
- [2026-03-17] standup/atlas/2026-03-17: Decided in today's standup: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, since storage for originals doubled in six months. For anything Atlas-related, page Priya.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-05-22] standup/boreal/2025-05-22: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14-2: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-09-05] standup/cinder/2025-09-05: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-4: The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-05-15] handover/2025-05-15-webhooks: Handover: as of today the webhook dispatcher moves from team Ember to the Boreal team. Oskar walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2: The Boreal team noticed that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.

Question: Who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who was responsible for the notifier on 2025-05-17.

Let me trace the notifier ownership:
- [2025-01-09] The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-06-11] handover: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-06-27] Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it.

So on 2025-05-17, the notifier was still owned by Boreal (the handover happened 2025-06-11, corrected to Dune).

Now, who was responsible on 2025-05-17 — on-call for Boreal?
- [2025-03-17] Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-05-07] Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-05-29] For anything Boreal-related, page Marcus.

So on 2025-05-17, Boreal on-call was Marcus Oyelaran (picked up 2025-05-07, and still Marcus on 2025-05-29).

Answer: Marcus (Oyelaran).
